# at time

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:atTime`](gmeow-atTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/atTime>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The instant at which a point-like event or observation occurred.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:atTime`](gmeow-atTime.md) from `?` to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:usedModel ex:assistant ;
    gmeow:samplingTemperature "0.2"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:atTime "2026-06-12T17:03:10Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:eventTemporalFrame gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian .

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to stamp a zero-duration occurrence — an event, a reading, a snapshot observation — with a single crisp dateTime, when no interval boundary is involved.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a bounded span (use a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md)) and for the time a claim was asserted or recorded (use the statement-layer clocks [`gmeow:assertedAt`](gmeow-assertedAt.md) / [`gmeow:recordedNoLaterThan`](gmeow-recordedNoLaterThan.md)); domain-free, so it carries no implied subject type.

### How to use

- Write a full [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) (P3, never [xsd:date](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date)) interpreted in the subject's temporal frame; for a point that needs its own frame or EDTF expression, model a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) instead.

### Examples

- ex:doorbellEvent [`gmeow:atTime`](gmeow-atTime.md) "2026-06-15T08:14:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
